mechanisms.title: Schedule Line Determination
mechanisms.memory_hook: Item category says what the item is. Schedule line says how quantity moves.
mechanisms.question: Should the quantity create requirements, run ATP, and become deliverable?
mechanisms.determination: Item category + MRP type determine the schedule line category according to configuration.
controls: goods issue or goods receipt behavior

failure_modes.symptom: Order item exists but no requirement or ATP behavior
failure_modes.prove: Check item category + MRP type → schedule line category → requirements/availability flags.
Prove schedule-line delivery relevance before investigating delivery creation.

tests.setup: Use the same item category with products carrying different MRP types.
tests.assert: Schedule-line determination follows the maintained item-category/MRP-type combination.

mechanisms.title: Delivering Plant Determination
mechanisms.memory_hook: Plant is a small field with an absurd amount of downstream authority.
mechanisms.question: Which plant owns the fulfillment promise for this item?
mechanisms.determination: For a sales item, the documented determination sequence checks customer-material information first, then ship-to, then material master.
configuration_surfaces: Master-data defaults and allowed organizational assignments

failure_modes.symptom: Wrong ATP result or unexpected intercompany behavior
failure_modes.prove: Prove the plant and its source before debugging ATP or company-code logic.
Plant is a mandatory upstream input for the usual shipping-point determination.

tests.setup: Maintain different plant values in customer-material and material master.
tests.assert: Customer-material information record takes precedence in the documented sequence.

mechanisms.title: Shipping Point Determination
mechanisms.memory_hook: Plant says where supply lives. Shipping point says who executes shipping.
mechanisms.question: Which shipping unit executes the delivery?
mechanisms.determination: The shipping point can be determined from plant alone or, for multiple shipping points, from plant + shipping condition + loading group.

failure_modes.prove: Check plant → shipping condition → loading group → maintained determination entry.

failure_modes.symptom: Order splits into separate deliveries unexpectedly
failure_modes.prove: Compare shipping points; a delivery requires items to share the same shipping point.

tests.setup: Use one plant with two shipping points distinguished by shipping condition/loading group.
tests.assert: The combination produces the expected shipping point.

mechanisms.title: Route Determination
mechanisms.memory_hook: Route turns geography and service level into time.
mechanisms.question: How should the goods travel, and what does that do to scheduling?
mechanisms.determination: Sales-order route uses departure geography + shipping condition + transportation group + destination geography. Delivery redetermination can additionally use weight group.
controls: integration context for downstream transportation execution

failure_modes.prove: Trace departure zone, shipping condition, transportation group and destination zone; then check delivery weight-group redetermination.

failure_modes.symptom: Delivery dates shift after route change
failure_modes.prove: Route influences transportation scheduling, so compare scheduling before/after route determination.

tests.setup: Keep origin/destination constant and change the shipping condition.
tests.assert: Route changes only when a matching route-determination combination exists.

tests.setup: Create a delivery whose weight moves into another configured weight group.
tests.assert: Delivery route can be redetermined according to the delivery rule.

mechanisms.title: ATP / aATP Product Availability
mechanisms.memory_hook: A requested date is a wish. A confirmed schedule line is the system's promise.
mechanisms.question: How much can we confirm, where, and when?
mechanisms.determination: Checking group + checking rule define the scope of availability check, which determines which stocks, receipts, issues and requirements participate in product availability.

failure_modes.symptom: Zero or late confirmation despite visible stock
failure_modes.prove: Check plant → checking group/rule → scope → stock segment and competing requirements.

failure_modes.symptom: Sales order and delivery confirm differently
failure_modes.prove: Order and delivery can use different checking rules; compare scope rather than only stock.

tests.setup: Create demand against controlled stock and a known future receipt.
tests.assert: Confirmation follows the configured scope and dates rather than raw unrestricted stock alone.
